description: This file defines the `PackageDetails` class, which models the dimensions, weight, and quantity details of a shipping package in the sales management system.

classes.name: PackageDetails
classes.description: A Java class representing shipping package attributes such as weight, dimensions, quantity, and item name.

methods.name: getItemName
methods.description: Returns the name of the item contained in the package.

methods.name: setItemName
methods.description: Sets the name of the item contained in the package.

methods.name: getShippingWeight
methods.description: Retrieves the weight of the package.

methods.name: setShippingWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the package.

methods.name: getShippingMaxWeight
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum weight the package can carry.

methods.name: setShippingMaxWeight
methods.description: Sets the maximum weight the package can carry.

methods.name: getShippingLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of the package.

methods.name: setShippingLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the package.

methods.name: getShippingHeight
methods.description: Retrieves the height of the package.

methods.name: setShippingHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the package.

methods.name: getShippingWidth
methods.description: Retrieves the width of the package.

methods.name: setShippingWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the package.

methods.name: getShippingQuantity
methods.description: Retrieves the quantity of items in the package.

methods.name: setShippingQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of items in the package.
